params.body:
## What

Removes the notification mail a garage's administrators received when a platform administrator started working inside its account ("Stocklist-beheer is ingelogd in jouw account om te helpen").

The mail only left with the `delegation_opt_in` flag on. It is not needed: the record of a delegated session is the trail (`delegation_logs`, `delegation_actions`) and the delegation log screen, and those do not depend on the flag.

## Removed

- `App\Mail\DelegationStartedMail` and its view `mails/delegation_started.blade.php`
- `Delegation::notifyDealer()` and its call in `Delegation::start()`, with the try/catch around it
- `Delegation::dealerAdmins()`: the mail was its only caller
- the five `delegation.mail_*` translation keys, in nl, en, fr and de
- the PHPStan baseline entry of the removed Mailable

## Reworded, because the text promised the mail

- `delegation.settings_help` (the help under the consent switch) no longer says "you receive an e-mail the moment they start", in the four languages
- the description of the `delegation_opt_in` flag on Beheer > Functies no longer says whoever looks in is reported to the administrators, in the four languages
- docblocks in `Delegation.php`, the comment in `config/features.php`, and a comment in `DealerController` that pointed at `dealerAdmins()`

## Unchanged

Everything else of delegated access: the trail, the bar and the way back, the five refusals, the dealer-level button and its choice of user, and the consent mechanism (`allow_delegated_access` with the `delegation_opt_in` flag). `Delegation::isDealerAdmin()` stays; it decides who may switch the consent and ranks the candidates.

`stocklist:mail-preview` had no entry for this mail.

## Business rules

- R P2-11.6 (the mail) is set to `vervallen`; the number stays reserved.
- R P2-11.4 (the trail) now says that the trail is the only notice: nobody is mailed, with the flag on or off.
- The introduction of P2-11 no longer says the dealer hears about it at once.
- The open point `meekijken-opt-in-zichtbaar-maken` drops the mail from its title and its to-do.

## Tests

The two tests that asserted the mail are replaced by:

- `test_starting_a_delegation_mails_nobody`, with the flag on and with the flag off: the delegation runs, the trail is written, nothing is sent or queued
- `test_a_dealer_without_an_administrator_is_not_mailed_on_its_general_address`

Both carry `@rule P2-11.4`.
params.title: No mail when we help inside a garage's account
